name: Brasada Ranch
label: Brasada Ranch
about_prose: Brasada Ranch is an 1,800-acre resort and residential community on the high-desert plateau of Powell Butte, at more than 3,000 feet. The land operated as a cattle ranch before development began in the mid-2000s, and the resort opened to guests in 2007. The master plan allows up to 750 home sites, and the community was the first Oregon resort to earn LEED Gold certification from the U.S. Green Building Council.

Nine hundred of the 1,800 acres are set aside as permanent open space, with trails for hiking, mountain biking, and equestrian use. Accommodations include Sage Canyon cabins, Cascade bungalows, and Ranch House suites. Membership and resort-guest access extends to the Brasada Canyons 18-hole golf course, Spa Brasada, indoor and outdoor pools, and two on-site restaurants.

amenities.name: Brasada Canyons Golf Course
amenities.description: An 18-hole course co-designed by Peter Jacobsen and Jim Hardy, opened in 2007. Eleven holes route through canyon terrain with five tee settings.

amenities.name: Ranch House Restaurant
amenities.description: Year-round casual dining serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with Cascade and high-desert views.

amenities.name: Range Restaurant and Bar
amenities.description: Seasonal farm-to-table dining featuring Oregon-sourced produce, meats, and dairy.

amenities.name: Spa Brasada
amenities.description: A four-treatment-room spa offering massage, facials, and body treatments, plus salon services.

amenities.name: Pool Complex
amenities.description: Sundance Pool with a seasonal waterslide and lazy river, an adults-only Cascade pool, outdoor hot tubs, and an indoor heated lap pool.

amenities.name: Equestrian Center
amenities.description: Guided trail rides on American Quarter horses across 900 acres of open land, with instructors and pony rides.

amenities.name: Athletic Center
amenities.description: Strength and cardio equipment, Peloton bikes, pilates and yoga classes, plus tennis and pickleball courts.

drive_times.note: Via US-20 and Powell Butte Highway

course_specs.summary: Brasada Canyons: 18 holes, five tee settings, opened 2007, designed by Peter Jacobsen and Jim Hardy. Eleven holes play through canyon terrain at 3,000+ ft with Cascade Range views.
